Re 
 Through: Mr. Amit Peswani, Advocate for
 Ms. Nandira Rao, Asc (crl.) f
 State & Wsi Shailja Ps Prasad
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

1.  Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
This petition seeks quashing of FIR No. 307/2016 PS Prasad Nagar under Section 498A/406/34 IPC on the basis of settlement dated 31st January 2022, which is on record of this Court.
2. Counsel for petitioner however seeks more time as draft of Rs.1,25,000/- which is to be handed over to respondent no.2, is not yet ready.
Respondent no.2 shall be intimated by the IO about the next date of hearing.
Petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 shall remain present before the Court on the next date of hearing.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this court.
